mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token_info(user_seq, token_value, expired_dt, use_yn, reg_dt, mod_dt) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{tokenValue}, #{expiredDt}, #{useYn}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_seq) DO UPDATE SET token_value = #{tokenValue}, expired_dt = #{expiredDt}, mod_dt = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.token_seq, r.token_value, r.expired_dt, r.use_yn, r.user_seq FROM refresh_token_info r WHERE r.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND r.use_yn = 'Y'
